mentions.name: Personal diagram/vector graphics tool
mentions.description: A personal diagram and vector graphics tool built with AI-assisted coding, designed around a UX the author would enjoy using rather than merely tolerate, serving as a replacement for their canceled Miro subscription.
mentions.problem: Miro's UX was something the author tolerated rather than enjoyed, prompting them to cancel their personal subscription and build a more enjoyable diagramming tool instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: Decided to cancel my personal Miro subscription, so vibe-coding* a diagram/vector graphics tool with UX I would enjoy rather than tolerate.
